confirmation: Are you sure you want to perform this operation?
description: Delete an async operation to delete the Azure AD for customers tenant and Azure resource. The resource deletion can only happen as the last step in [the tenant deletion process](https://aka.ms/delete-ciam-tenant).

operations.description: Initiates an async operation to delete the Azure AD for customers tenant and Azure resource. The resource deletion can only happen as the last step in [the tenant deletion process](https://aka.ms/delete-ciam-tenant).

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The initial sub domain of the tenant.
params.name: resourceName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription. The value must be an UUID.
params.name: subscriptionId

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

responses.description: Resource deletion request accepted. The Azure-AsyncOperation header indicates the URL/location in which to poll for a result of the asynchronous operation.
NoContent - Azure AD for customers tenant resource successfully deleted or didn't exist.
Error response describing why the operation failed.
